items.title: 1 value stock to own for decades and 2 we ignore
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.

items.title: BrightSpring Soars 12% on Q3 Beat and Raised 2026 Guidance as Adjusted EBITDA Jumps 42%
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrightSpring Health Services stock jumped 12% as adjusted EBITDA rose 42% and 2026 guidance went up. Gross profit per script rose 27% in what management calls the peak year for Medicare’s drug-price negotiations.
